title: Heterogeneous runner for multiprotocol stream fidelity and toolchain conformance
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a flexible regression runner that executes the same test scenarios across multiple streaming protocols (chunked HTTP, multiplexed websocket, ndjson over HTTP), tool/function call encodings, and structured-output modes. The runner must exercise golden prompts, synthetic fuzz cases, KV cache priming, and graceful partial-JSON recovery to detect compatibility regressions between runtime releases and model variants.
acceptance_criteria: Runner can execute a single test definition across at least three transport protocols with the same assertions and produce a unified canonical report.
Golden prompt corpus (initial 120 seeds) executes end-to-end and all mismatches are captured as classifier-diff artifacts in CI.
CI job created that runs fast-smoke (30 tests) on each PR and nightly full-suite (1200+ scenarios) with artifact retention for 14 days.
Tool/function call scenarios validate call start/emit/complete events, tool-channel interleaving, and idempotent replays with recorded stubs.
Structured output checks include schema roundtrips, partial-recovery heuristics, and clear failure codes for parse vs. semantic drift.
Cross-version compatibility matrix added that runs combos of runtime-{1.20,1.21,1.22} x model-variants {v0,v1-q4} for a representative subset.
Automated KV cache priming scenarios included: prefix-reuse, cold-hot switch, and cache-eviction simulation; deviations flagged if token delta > 2x baseline.
Latency and jitter SLO regression detection: median latency must not regress >20% and p95 must remain within accepted bounds defined in monitoring playbook.
Test runner emits machine-readable artifacts: ndjson event streams, JSON diff summary, and contextual logs (all accessible via CI artifacts).
tasks: Design canonical test schema for protocol-agnostic scenarios (events, assertions, golden-seed references)
Implement transport adapters: chunked-HTTP, multiplexed-websocket, ndjson-over-HTTP
Add tool-call stub server that can simulate delays, partial responses, and deterministic replay
Integrate KV-cache priming harness and measurement probes into runner
Create golden prompt corpus export and seeding utility with metadata tags
Wire runner into GitHub Actions with PR-smoke and nightly matrix workflows
Add artifact uploader and retention policy (14 days) and link to Console test-report view
Author runbook describing interpretation of diffs and escalation path for high-severity regressions
notes: Goal is to catch regressions introduced by kernel selection, streaming patches, and protocol shims before they reach canary. Keep the first iteration small and iterate on failure triage UX. Coordinate with QA to seed known flaky cases to validate signal/noise thresholds.
